tidbit: Did you know… one story this hour was carried by two different outlets in the last few hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Mistral AI releases Large 4, an open-weight model built for cybersecurity, Confirmed by Crypto Briefing. The model has 1 trillion parameters and 1 million token context.
Google unveils new Gemini 4 Carbon AI model, Confirmed by Deccan Herald. It leads in cybersecurity and coding, priced at $2 and $10 per million tokens.
Sam Altman says OpenAI will point its robots at building data centres, Confirmed by The Next Web. The AI robots may build self-replicating data centres with cost estimates and security concerns.
Amazon AWS posts 39 percent revenue growth as cloud rivals also accelerate, Confirmed by CNBC. AWS grows 39 percent year over year, aiming for trillion-dollar revenue by 2030.
Cal Poly Unveils NVIDIA-Powered AI Factory to Expand AI Education and Research, Reported by Cal Poly. The factory advances artificial intelligence education and research on campus.
Free every hour.
